from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc8628.endpoints.device_authorization import DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint


class MockRequestValidator:
    def authenticate_client(self, request):
        return True


request_validator = MockRequestValidator()
verification_uri = "https://example.com/device"
expires_in = 600
interval = 5
endpoint = DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint(
    request_validator=request_validator,
    verification_uri=verification_uri,
    expires_in=expires_in,
    interval=interval,
)

assert endpoint.request_validator is request_validator
for name, expected in (
    ("verification_uri", verification_uri),
    ("expires_in", expires_in),
    ("interval", interval),
):
    actual = getattr(endpoint, name)
    print(f"{name}: expected={expected!r}, actual={actual!r}")
    assert actual == expected
print("Constructor preserves the original validator and all configuration values.")
